headline: A 1998 executive order directs federal agencies to focus on improving education for American Indian and Alaska Native students.
what_it_does: This executive order is about the education of American Indian and Alaska Native students. Based on its title, it sets federal policy and gives directions to federal agencies on schooling for these students. No official summary was provided, so the specific goals, programs, and requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: American Indian and Alaska Native students
who_it_affects.how: The order is meant to shape federal efforts on the education these students receive.

who_it_affects.group: Tribal and Bureau of Indian Affairs schools, and public schools serving Native students
who_it_affects.how: These schools may be affected by federal education policies and agency actions that follow from the order.
The order gives these agencies direction on how to handle American Indian and Alaska Native education.

when_it_takes_effect: 1998-08-06 (date signed; executive orders usually take effect when signed)
